candidates.change_summary: Replace `return _owner;` with `return address(0);` so owner() always returns the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Replace `return _owner;` with `return _msgSender();` so owner() returns the caller instead of the stored owner.
Removed the require check on newOwner so ownership can be transferred to the zero address.
Replaced _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(_msgSender()) so the caller always becomes the owner.
Replaced _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(address(0)) so any call renounces ownership instead.
Inverted the zero-address check so only transferring to the zero address is allowed.
Removed the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can invoke transferOwnership.
